## Description

Optimizes portfolio weights by minimizing entropic risk measures directly over Riemannian manifolds of Symmetric Positive Definite matrices, ensuring robust non-Euclidean risk-adjusted returns.

## Where it may fit

Fat-tailed risk-adjusted portfolio allocation, structural macro regime shifts, multi-asset endowment management.

## Vehicles

Institutional Endowment Portfolios, Risk-Parity Funds, Quantitative Asset Managers.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, historical return panels, entropic risk aversion parameters.

## Caveats

Manifold metric gradient descent requires careful step-size tuning to maintain numerical stability.
